newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City Power Q3 hurt by mild weather.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City Power Q3 hurt by mild weather.

text.p: Kansas City Power & Light Co said Monday its third quarter earnings declined from a year ago, due in part to milder than normal weather this quarter.

Kansas City Power said its third quarter earnings also were reduced by $0.26 a share in the third quarter due to terminating a merger with UtiliCop United Inc and continuing to defend against Western Resources Inc's hostile offer.
The utility reported third quarter earnings of $0.57 a share, down from $0.91 last year.

"We made an investment in a strategic merger with UtiliCorp," Drue Jennings, chairman, said in a statement. "However, due to Western Resoures' proxy content, the efforts to obtain shareholder approval of the merger with UtiliCorp fell short and we expensed the deferred merger costs."

Retail revenues for the third quarter fell four percent to $252 million, reflecting a five percent drop in retail kilowatt hour sales from the 1995 third quarter. Operating revenues were down to $270.2 million from $277.7 million.
